2017-12-08 4.3.1 AUTOSAR Release Management
• Editorial changes 2016-11-30 4.3.0 AUTOSAR Release Management
• Chapters Runtime Errors, and Transient Faults have been established
• Development Error Tracer has been replaced by Default Error Tracer
• Meta Data handling has been introduced
• Requirements about handling negative TxConfirmations has been added. 2015-07-31 4.2.2 AUTOSAR Release Management
• Changed attribute Ecuc.postBuildVariantValue to false for FrApTpSduRxId and FrArTpSduTxId 2014-10-31 4.2.1 AUTOSAR Release Management
• Clarification regarding NULL pointer handling
• Removed obsolete ECU configuration elements 2014-03-31 4.1.3 AUTOSAR Release Management
• Clarified meaning of FrArTpTc
• Clarified requirements for sending FC(OVFLW)
• Revised routing path const correctness
• Harmonization of API descriptions 2013-10-31 4.1.2 AUTOSAR Release Management
• Retry of FrIf_Transmit mechanism has been removed in case this API returns E_NOT_OK
• Removed FRARTP prefix for fields of FrTp frames and used camel case notation consistently for EcuC parameters
• Removed NotifyResultType from ComStackTypes and replaced by Std_ReturnType in the APIs
• Removed the ’Timing’ row from the API table(s) of chapter ’Scheduled Functions’
• Editorial changes
• Removed chapter(s) on change documentation
▽
